answer: At the admission wharf every new agent posts a 500-token bond in a vesting escrow whose clock starts at posting and cannot be accelerated. Three rotating witnesses verify the escrow each epoch and emit a plume receipt before the agent leaves the island of unverified identities. Withdrawal opens only after a 90-day vest; a re-keyed identity inherits the original unlock date, so attackers cannot reset or parallelize capital. Each identity costs 500 tokens locked 90 days, about 12.5 forgone yield at 10% APR, linear in n; collusive bonds are burned, keeping sybil cost linear.
